chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khald al-Barqi; and Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah narrated to me from his father 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Abu 'Abdillah al-Barqi, from Ja'far ibn Najiyah, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Pray at the head of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Where should one pray according to the narration from Imam al-Sadiq regarding the grave of Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through a robust chain of Qummi scholars in *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, establishes the permissibility and virtue of offering prayer at the head of Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) grave, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating physical proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt with spiritual devotion. It underscores the grave not merely as a burial site but as a locus of divine connection, where the intercession and presence of the Imam enhance the worshipper's engagement with God.
